name: China National Aviation Holding Corporation Limited (CNAHC)
via: A PRC state-owned enterprise under the supervision of the State Council, per Air China's Interim Report 2025; CNAHC and its wholly-owned subsidiary CNACG collectively hold 53.71% of Air China
note: Controlling shareholder of Air China Limited. Air China's interim report 2025 (notes to the financial statements) names CNAHC as the company's parent and ultimate holding company, 'a PRC state-owned enterprise under the supervision of the State Council'; Air China's April 2025 announcement puts CNAHC and CNACG's combined holding at 53.71% of the company's shares.
